jobs:
  toml-test:
    name: toml-test ${{ matrix.toml-version }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        toml-version: ['1.0.0', '1.1.0']

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '4.0'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Install toml-test
        run: go install github.com/toml-lang/toml-test/v2/cmd/toml-test@v2.2.0

      - name: Make decoder executable
        run: chmod +x tool/toml-test-decoder

      - name: Run toml-test (${{ matrix.toml-version }})
        run: |
          version="${{ matrix.toml-version }}"
          short="${version%.*}"  # 1.0.0 -> 1.0
          skip_file=".github/toml-test-skip-${short}.txt"
          skips=$(grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' "$skip_file" | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | paste -sd, -)
          echo "Skipping: $skips"
          "$(go env GOPATH)/bin/toml-test" test \
            -decoder ./tool/toml-test-decoder \
            -toml "$version" \
            -timeout 10s \
            -skip "$skips" \
            -skip-must-err
